messages:
cleo: heads up — trying to publish samplekit and the publish flow is blocked by a typegen/regendiff mismatch. CI says default docs were removed so semver decision flipped.
publish-bot: build failed on job #582: regendiff check failed (1 file changed) — https://ci.redwood.example/582 
benji: ugh. which file? can you paste the diff?
cleo: pasted in thread — snippet: ```diff
- docs/sampleapp/defaults.md
+ <removed>
```
samir: that file should never be removed by typegen, it’s user-authored. looks like the new default-pruning logic ate it during regen.
cleo: repro locally: `yarn typegen:regen` then `git status` shows docs deletion. tried `--keep-user-files` and it ignored it.
benji: is this the same nondet sort bug we saw earlier with OpenAPI property ordering? could manifest as doc churn and false semver bumps.
devex-bot: FYI — open PR template for publish blockers: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/pulls/new?template=publish_blocker.md
jen: filing: https://git.redwood/eng/devex/issues/1442 — title: "typegen: user docs removed by default-prune during regen". adding label: regendiff, ci-blocker. assigning @benji.
benji: quick workaround — `git checkout -- docs/sampleapp/defaults.md && git commit --no-verify -m "preserve docs while we fix regen"` then rerun publish. not ideal but unblocks.
cleo: can confirm workaround unblocks the CI job, but it’s scary to keep doing this. we need a presubmit check to fail if typegen removes files under /docs/ that are not in the spec directory.
samir: I can add a lint in the typegen pipeline: verify regen doesn't delete non-generated paths and flag any deletion as manual-review-required. will open PR.
jen: also let's add a changelog note for release engineering — this behavior can flip semver (file removal -> minor bump) and break downstream SDK publishes.
cleo: thanks. created a small README snippet for onboarding: mention to run `yarn typegen:preview` and inspect regendiff before opening a release PR.
benji: filed a hotfix PR to disable the prune heuristics by default: https://git.redwood/eng/devex/pulls/2134 — adding reviewers @samir @jen. please prioritize — this blocks a customer release. :exclamation:
devex-bot: CI rerun started for #582 after manual commit.
publish-bot: publish job resumed — currently waiting on npm token rotation check.
jen: long term we should surface regendiff in the console UI too, not just CI logs. UX + DX win.
cleo: agree. added to roadmap item 4.2. small follow-up: anyone hit flaky reorders with typegen on Windows dev machines? saw extra churn there as well.
samir: noted — will include stable-sort flag and a test case in the PR.
cleo: awesome. thanks all — will merge the temp preservation commit and monitor the publish.
